ammonia.reason: Short 2-3 mo age and low deamination limits free NH3 from amino acid catabolism.

animal_barnyard.reason: No washed-rind Brevibacterium; negligible p-cresol/indole from tyrosine/tryptophan degradation.

bitter.reason: Low-moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin cleavage; lactococcal peptidases largely debitter in young cheese.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no C7-C11 methyl ketone blue pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard from residual lactose/galactose plus lysine on heating.

buttery.reason: Moderate diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate free butanoic/hexanoic acids from starter esterase lipolysis; moderate lipolysis type.

creaminess.reason: 30-31% fat gives mouthfeel but low-pH crumbly fracture reduces creamy coalescence.

crumbliness.reason: Signature short fracture from low pH, early acid drain, milled dry-salted curd and calcium loss.

firmness.reason: Firm pressed body at ~37.6% moisture and pH ~4.85-5.2 with calcium-phosphate solubilization.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by lactococci.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with starter ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids; no caprine character.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism in short proteolysis.

melt.reason: Moderate flow when heated; pH ~5.0 para-casein melts grainy, less complete than young Cheddar.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No bloomy/soil molds; negligible 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil on heating from 30% fat and acid-weakened casein emulsion.

smoky.reason: Typical White/Red Cheshire unsmoked; no wood-smoke guaiacol/phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Distinct lactic tang from early high-acid drain plus trace acetic acid from starter fermentation.

stretch.reason: Rennet-pressed non-pasta-filata curd with no hot-water kneading; no aligned casein fibres.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide; no high-heat whey denaturation and limited methionine catabolism.

sweet.reason: Low residual lactose, slight sweet from glycerol/proline; high acidity suppresses sweetness.

umami.reason: Moderate free glutamate from early chymosin plus lactococcal peptidase proteolysis.
